items.title: Linux Finally Making It Easier To Answer The Question: "Is This RISC-V System RVA23?"
items.summary: The RISC-V RVA23 profile is a big deal for reducing fragmentation in the RISC-V ecosystem and standardizing more of the ISA to make it easier to distribute modern RISC-V binaries and the like. Modern versions of Ubuntu mandate RVA23 even though compliant hardware is still quite limited. Somewhat surprisingly, only coming about now is an easy ability for Linux users to find the answer to "is my RISC-V system RVA23 compliant?" Pending Linux kernel patches are finally offering a one-shot way of telling you...
items.title_zh: Linux 内核补丁将让用户轻松识别 RISC-V 系统是否符合 RVA23 规范
items.summary_zh: RISC-V RVA23 profile 是减少生态碎片化、标准化 ISA 的关键规范，现代版 Ubuntu 已强制要求硬件支持。但用户此前难以直接判断系统是否合规，待合并的 Linux 内核补丁终于提供一键查询方式。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 有助于推动 RVA23 标准落地，方便开发者和用户验证硬件兼容性，加速 RISC-V 生态成熟。

items.title: Avaota F2 – Allwinner V861 RISC-V SBC targets AI cameras with PTZ and audio support
items.summary: Avaota F2 is the first SBC based on an Allwinner V861 dual-core 64-bit RISC-V SoC with 128MB on-chip DDR3 memory, support for 4K cameras, H.265 video codec, and a 1 TOPS AI accelerator. It’s an update to the earlier Avaota F1 camera board based on an Allwinner V821 SoC. The new open-source hardware F2 SBC offers several benefits, including support for both Full HD and 4K camera sensors, motor control for the PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom) feature, and improved audio support through speaker (one) and microphone (two) connectors. However, the F1 also included WiFi, which the Avaota F2 lacks. items.why_it_matters_zh: 全志V861首次用于SBC，1 TOPS AI算力结合4K视频能力，适合AI相机开发。

items.title: Orange Pi O1 SBC features 16 TOPS SOPHGO BM1688 AI SoC, supports 4G/5G cellular connectivity
items.summary: Orange Pi O1 is a new single board computer (SBC) based on the somewhat older SOPHGO BM1688 octa-core Cortex-A53 SoC with a built-in 16 TOPS AI accelerator/TPU, and support for decoding up to sixteen 1080p30 video streams, or encoding ten. The board comes with 8GB or 16GB memory, supports M.2 NVMe, eMMC module, SPI flash, SATA III, or microSD card storage, and offers HDMI and MIPI DSI display interfaces, two MIPI CSI camera connectors, dual GbE, WiFi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, and optional 4G/5G cellular connectivity, as well as a few USB ports, audio interfaces, and a 26-pin GPIO header for expansion. Orange Pi O1 specifications: SoC – SOPHGO BM1688 CPU 8-core Arm Cortex-A53 processor @ 1.65 GHz RISC-V C906 co-processor @ 1.2 GHz TPU – SOPHGO Neural Network Acceleration Engine (TPU), delivering 16 TOPS @ INT8 VPU Video decoding – H.264 & H.265 up to 16 channels at 1080p30 Video [...] The post Orange Pi O1 SBC features 16 TOPS SOPHGO BM1688 AI SoC, supports 4G/5G cellular connectivity appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: Efinix Sapphire RV64 SoC – Configurable RISC-V soft-cores with DDR3, LPDDR4x, and HyperRAM for Efinix FPGAs
items.summary: Efinix has introduced the Sapphire RV64 SoC, a configurable 64-bit RISC-V soft-core processor designed for its Titanium and Trion FPGAs. It is based on the VexiiRiscv core and can be configured with one to four RISC-V cores running at up to 400 MHz. The Sapphire RV64 has a seven-stage pipeline, configurable L1 caches, optional 64–512 KB L2 cache, and 4–512 KB of on-chip RAM. It supports DDR3, LPDDR4x, and HyperRAM with up to 512-bit AXI interfaces and external memory from 4 MB to 8 GB. Other features include an optional FPU, branch predictor, prefetchers, SV39 MMU, up to 32 GPIOs, five I²C, three SPI, three UARTs, timers, watchdog, and up to eight user interrupts. Efinix Sapphire RV64 SoC specifications: CPU 1 to 4x VexiiRiscv 64-bit cores with a 7-stage pipeline (fetch, align-decompress, decode, issue, execute, memory, and writeback) Configurable system clock frequency from 20 MHz to 400 MHz Supports RV64IMACFD_Zba_Zbc_Zbs extensions [...] The post Efinix Sapphire RV64 SoC – Configurable RISC-V soft-cores with DDR3, LPDDR4x, and HyperRAM for Efinix FPGAs appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: HPMicro HPM5100 RISC-V MCU integrates four 16-bit ADCs, four op-amps for analog sensing and motor control
items.summary: HPMicro has introduced the HPM5100 series, a family of 32-bit RISC-V mixed-signal MCUs, starting with the HPM5151 parts. It features a 400 MHz RISC-V processor, 416 KB SRAM, 1 MB flash, four 16-bit ADCs, four operational amplifiers, and four analog comparators. It also includes a high-speed USB 2.0 OTG interface with an integrated PHY, CAN FD, multiple UART/SPI/I2C interfaces, and 32 PWM channels for motor control. The chip supports hardware floating-point operations and DSP instructions, while the integrated analog peripherals reduce the need for external ADCs and signal-conditioning circuits. items.why_it_matters_zh: 集成模拟外设可减少外部ADC与信号调理电路，简化电机控制与传感系统设计。

items.title: Romu – A Tiny Raspberry Pi RP2354A board for USB application development (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: Bitmerse Romu is a tiny (15.5 x 12 mm), almost minimal Raspberry Pi RP2354A USB board with a USB 2.0 interface on one side of the PCB, and the dual Cortex-M33/RISC-V MCU on the other side, connected to a few debugging/programming pads, buttons, and an RGB LED. It doesn’t come with any GPIO, and it’s mostly designed for USB applications such as a security key for passwordless login, a USB MIDI controller, a macro pad, or a custom HID device. You can plug it directly into a spare USB Type-A port of your computer/host without any cables, breadboard, or adapters required. items.title: VIEWE launches 4.3-inch ESP32-S31 display development board
items.summary: VIEWE has introduced the PLCM-UES31S043H800V480C-U, a 4.3-inch smart display module that appears to be the first third-party development board powered by the new ESP32-S31 MCU. The board includes a 4.3-inch display with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4 LE and Classic, and IEEE 802.15.4 for Zigbee and Thread. It also features USB-C and USB-A ports, a microSD card slot, RS485 and CAN interfaces, and a 20-pin GPIO expansion header with UART and I2C. The board also includes an ES8389 audio codec, two NS4150B amplifiers, two onboard microphones, four ADC buttons, a WS2812B RGB LED, and BOOT/RESET buttons. It operates on a 5V power supply and supports an operating temperature range of -20°C to +70°C. items.title: M5Stack ToughC5 weatherproof ESP32-C5 IoT controller offers dual-band Wi-Fi 6, BLE 5, and Zigbee/Thread
items.summary: M5Stack has just introduced the ToughC5, a rugged, weatherproof outdoor IoT controller built around the ESP32-C5. The device features a bright 2.0-inch capacitive touch IPS display and RS485 connectivity. The ToughC5 is an upgrade to the ESP32-base3d M5Stack TOUGH introduced in 2021, with the upgraded model featuring a more modern ESP32-C5 MCU with dual-band (2.4/5 GHz) Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5 LE, and an IEEE 802.15.4 radio for Zigbee and Thread. Other changes include faster Octal PSRAM, an upgraded RTC chip with a dedicated coin cell backup battery, a passive buzzer replacing the previous 1W speaker, and a custom power management system (M5PM1 + M5IOE1) replacing the AXP192 PMU. These features make it suitable for industrial field control, outdoor edge data collection, and smart building applications. items.title: Q8botOne – A palm-sized open-source quadruped robot with ESP32-C3, DYNAMIXEL smart actuators (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: ZeroWire Robotics Q8botOne is an open-source, palm-sized quadruped robot built around an ESP32-C3 MCU and ROBOTIS DYNAMIXEL smart actuators. Designed with a unique wire-free architecture, the robot integrates all components onto a central printed circuit board also used as the structural chassis. The robot is roughly the size of a smartphone and can jog, jump, and carry up to twice its 250-gram weight. The main PCB uses a dedicated 6V/16A step-down converter for motor power and includes a battery management system for two 14500 Li-ion cells. For control, the kit includes a separate ESP32-C3 controller PCB with an Adafruit Mini I2C Gamepad. items.title: After 23 Years, Longtime Linux Developer To "Step Back For A While"
items.summary: Longtime Linux kernel engineer Darrick Wong who stepped down as the XFS file-system maintainer in 2023 is now taking a step back from his other Linux kernel development roles after working on the kernel the past 23 years...
items.title_zh: 资深Linux内核开发者Darrick Wong宣布暂退开发工作
items.summary_zh: 拥有23年Linux内核开发经验的工程师Darrick Wong此前已于2023年卸任XFS文件系统维护者一职，近日他宣布暂时退出其余Linux内核开发工作，进行休整。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 核心维护者长期更替难题再次凸显，XFS等关键文件系统的后续维护与社区走向值得关注。

items.summary: With pending code for Mesa, the LLVMpipe software-based Gallium3D/OpenGL driver could soon become faster on modern systems that support AVX-512. That's assuming the AI/LLVM-generated code is all in order...

items.summary_zh: Mesa中待合并的代码有望让基于软件的Gallium3D/OpenGL驱动LLVMpipe在支持AVX-512的现代系统上获得加速，前提是AI/LLVM生成的代码没有问题。

items.title: Microchip MTCH3380P and MTCH3240P capacitive touch controllers support up to 64 buttons with parallel sensing
items.summary: Microchip Technology has introduced the MTCH3380P and MTCH3240P, two new capacitive touch controllers that handle touch detection internally, making it easier to build display-free HMI devices with touch-sensitive buttons, sliders, and wheels. The main difference between the two controllers is the number of supported touch sensors. The MTCH3380P supports up to 38 self-capacitance or 64 mutual-capacitance keys, while the smaller MTCH3240P supports up to 24 self-capacitance or 32 mutual-capacitance keys. Both controllers use parallel sensing with 12 on-chip ADCs to improve touch response times and noise immunity. They also support touch detection through thick cover materials and when users are wearing gloves, making them suitable for home appliances, industrial control panels, EV chargers, and outdoor kiosks. Both also support IEC/UL 60730 Class B functional safety requirements. Microchip MTCH3380P and MTCH3240P specifications: Controller engine – Microchip patented charge-transfer acquisition engine with pipelined analog sensing and digital processing. items.title: Dragonwing FWA Gen 6 Elite Platform combines 5G Advanced, NR-NTN, and tri-band Wi-Fi 8
items.summary: Unveiled at Network X 2026, the Qualcomm Dragonwing FWA Gen 6 Elite Platform combines 5G Advanced (3GPP Rel-19), NR-NTN (New Radio – Non-Terrestrial Networks) satellite communication, and tri-band Wi-Fi 8 with a 5×5 radio configuration. The new Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) solution features a Qualcomm X105 Modem-RF with 5G NR over satellite support, quad-frequency GNSS (L1, L2, L5, and L6), Qualcomm Turbo DSDA for 60% higher throughput compared to Gen 5, a quad-core CPU, an integrated 10 TOPS NPU, LPDDR4x and LPDDR5/5x, and quantum security (CNSA 2.0 compliant). It offers 500 MHz of aggregated bandwidth, 6- and 8-layer MIMO, peak download and upload speeds of 14.8 Gbps and 4.2 Gbps, respectively.
